blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Many useful latent distributions can be sampled but do not have a tractable density. Such distributions may be represented by empirical collections of real-world observations or generated by scientific simulators and black-box generative models. These sample-only priors cannot be used directly in likelihood-based normalizing flows, which require evaluating the prior density. We propose Projected Characteristic-Function matching (PCF), a density-free framework for learning an invertible map between a data distribution and a prior specified only through samples.
  Our method aligns distributions using projected empirical characteristic functions, eliminating the need for density estimation, adversarial training, or paired observations. To address the non-uniqueness of the transport map, we introduce an optional transport regularizer that selects lower-displacement transformations while preserving endpoint alignment.
  We benchmark PCF on controlled transports, sample-efficiency studies, and high-dimensional alignment tasks. PCF matches the accuracy of kernel MMD on the controlled benchmark and on raw-pixel MNIST--USPS at a cost linear in the batch size, and it is more sample-efficient, achieving lower endpoint error than MMD in 13 of 15 paired runs across library sizes. By avoiding pairwise kernel evaluation, it reduces discrepancy memory by 29.8% and trains at batch sizes where kernel MMD exceeds GPU memory. These results show that PCF provides accurate and efficient invertible transport, particularly in sample- and memory-limited settings.
blocks.zh:
许多有用的潜在分布可取样,但密度不易拉动。 这种分布可能表现为实际世界观测的经验性收集或由科学模拟器和黑盒基因模型生成. 这些只有样本的前科不能直接用于基于概率的常态化流,这需要评价先前的密度. 我们提出预测特征-功能匹配(PCF),这是在数据分布和仅通过样本指定的先前地图之间学习不可逆图的无密度框架.
我们的方法利用预测的经验特征功能来调整分布,从而不再需要密度估计、对抗性训练或对等观测。 为解决运输图的非独特性,我们引入了一种可选的运输规范化器,在保留端点对齐的同时,选择更低位位移转换.
我们以受控运输、样本效率研究以及高维度对齐任务为基准来衡量PCF。 PCF在控制基准和原始像素 MNIST-USPS上以批量大小的成本线性匹配内核MMD的精度,且其样本效率更高,在15对运行的13对中实现了比MMD更低的端点误差. 通过避免双向内核评价,将差异内存减少29.8%,在内核MMD超过GPU内存的批量规模下进行列车. 这些结果显示,PCF提供了准确有效的不可逆运输,特别是在样本和内存有限的环境下.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Learning a transformation between two probability distributions from finite, unpaired samples is a fundamental problem in generative modeling, domain translation, simulation-based inference, and representation learning. In many of these settings, it is desirable for the transformation to be invertible: samples should be transported in both directions, and every generated observation should admit an exact representation in the source space. Normalizing flows provide a natural framework for learning such transformations through compositions of invertible functions or continuous-time dynamics ( Dinh, Sohl-Dickstein, and Bengio 2017 ; Kingma and Dhariwal 2018 ; Chen et al. 2018 ; Grathwohl et al. 2019 ; Papamakarios et al. 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 学习从有限,未标本中两种概率分布之间的转变,是基因模型化,域域翻译,模拟推论,和表现学中的一个基本问题. 在许多这种情况下,转变是不可逆的:样品应双向运输,每一次产生的观测都应承认在源空间有确切的表示。 使流动正常化为通过不可逆函数的构成或连续时间动态学习这种转变提供了自然框架(Dinh、Sohl-Dickstein和Bengio 2017;Kingma和Dhariwal)。 2018; 陈等. 2018; Grathwohl 等人 2019; Papamakarios 等人 2021).

blocks.en: The standard normalizing-flow formulation, however, is designed around a tractable base distribution, most commonly an isotropic Gaussian. Maximum-likelihood training evaluates the density of an encoded observation under this base law together with the change-of-variables correction. This construction is effective when the base distribution is chosen for computational convenience, but it does not directly address settings in which the latent distribution is externally prescribed and accessible only through samples. Such sample-only priors can arise from simulators, collections of trajectories, empirical latent libraries, molecular samplers, physical state distributions, or black-box generative models. In these cases, the structure of the prior carries information: it defines the coordinate law in which observations should be represented, rather than merely supplying unstructured noise for generation.
blocks.zh: 然而,标准常态化-流配体的设计围绕着可牵引基分布,最常见的是异构高斯. 最大相似性训练会评价一个编码观测在这个基法下的密度,以及变异性修正. 这种构造在选用基础分布为计算方便时是有效的,但它并不直接针对潜在分布由外部规定且只能通过样品获取的设置. 此类仅标本的前科可以来自模拟器,轨迹集,经验潜伏库,分子样本器,物理状态分布,或黑盒基因模型. 在这些情况下,前一种结构包含信息:它界定了应表达观测结果的坐标法,而不仅仅是为生成提供无结构噪声。

blocks.en: Recent work has expanded invertible generative modeling beyond conventional maximum-likelihood training. Sample-based objectives, including sliced-Wasserstein discrepancies, energy and proper-scoring-rule losses, and score matching, show that normalizing flows can be trained without relying exclusively on tractable likelihoods ( Coeurdoux, Dobigeon, and Chainais 2022 ; Chao et al. 2023 ) . However, these approaches typically retain an analytically specified base distribution or focus on modeling a single target law. Fitting an auxiliary density model to samples from the desired prior offers one alternative ( Golling et al. 2023 ) , but introduces an additional estimation stage whose errors can affect the learned transport. Path-based approaches such as Flow Matching instead learn dynamics along a chosen probability path between the endpoints ( Lipman et al. 2023 ) , while drifting methods construct distributional dynamics from discrepancies or gradient flows ( Gretton et al. 2026 ) . Although these methods can operate with samples from both distributions, they require an interpolation, coupling, or drift construction beyond the endpoint laws themselves. Flow Matching, in particular, learns the endpoint laws only indirectly through coupled samples; with the same network, solver, and training budget, its endpoint error is 2.5–3.7 times that of PCF in our controlled benchmark.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作扩大了不可逆的基因模型,超越了传统的最大相似性训练。 基于样本的目标,包括切片-Wasserstein差异、能量和正确评分规则损失,以及分数比对,表明正常流动可以接受培训,而不完全依赖可拉动的可能性 (Coeurdoux, Dobigeon, and Chaneis 2022;Chao等人,2023年). 然而,这些办法通常保留在分析上具体规定的基础分布或侧重于制定单一的目标法。 将一个辅助密度模型与所期望的先前的样本相配,提供了一种替代品(Golling等人,2023年),但引入了一个额外的估计阶段,其误差可影响所学的迁移。 基于路径的方法,如流动匹配,而是沿着端点之间的选定概率路径学习动态(Lipman等人,2023年),而漂移方法则通过差异或梯度流构建分布动态(Gretton等人,2026年)。 虽然这些方法可以用两种分布的样品来操作,但是它们需要内插,耦合,或漂移构造超越终点定律本身. 特别是,“流量匹配”只通过组合样本间接地学习端点定律;使用同样的网络、解析器和培训预算,其端点误差是我们控制基准的2.5-3.7倍。

blocks.en: Our starting point is LeJEPA, which introduces Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization to match learned representations to an isotropic Gaussian through projected empirical characteristic functions ( Balestriero and LeCun 2025 ) . This construction combines random one-dimensional projections with characteristic-function comparisons, providing a scalable sample-based mechanism for controlling a high-dimensional distribution. We extend this mechanism from representation regularization toward a fixed Gaussian law to invertible generative modeling between general sample-defined endpoint distributions. The proposed objective matches encoded data to independent prior samples and decoded prior samples to independent data samples, requiring neither prior-density evaluation, adversarial training, nor source–target pairings. We study both an unregularized formulation, which enforces the endpoint distributions, and a transport-regularized formulation, which additionally favors lower-cost invertible maps.
blocks.zh: 我们的出发点是LeJEPA,它引入了Sketched Isotropic Gaussian规范化,通过预测的经验性特征功能(Balestriero和LeCun 2025),将学到的表述与异性高斯人相匹配。 这种构造将随机的一维预测与特征函数比较相结合,为控制高维分布提供了可伸缩的样本机制. 我们把这种机制从代表规范化扩大到固定的高斯定律,在一般的样本定义终点分布之间形成不可逆的基因模型。 拟议目标将编码数据与独立的先前样本相匹配,并将先前的样本与独立的数据样本进行解码,既不需要事先密度评价、对抗性训练,也不要求源-目标配对。 我们既研究执行端点分布的不规范化配方,也研究运输规范化配方,这还有利于低成本的不可逆图.

blocks.en: The approach is motivated by the fact that characteristic functions uniquely characterize probability distributions and by the Cramér–Wold principle, which reduces multivariate distribution matching to comparisons of one-dimensional projections ( Cramér and Wold 1936 ; Epps and Pulley 1983 ) . Random directions and a multiscale frequency grid yield a differentiable minibatch objective based on bounded Fourier features ( Ansari, Scarlett, and Soh 2020 ; Knop et al. 2020 ) . We state endpoint identifiability for the idealized all-direction, all-frequency discrepancy and evaluate its practical finite-grid surrogate against alternative endpoint, path-based, and likelihood-based objectives.
blocks.zh: 这种方法的动机是,特性函数是概率分布的独特特征,以及Cramér-Wold原则,该原则减少了与一维预测的比较相匹配的多变量分布(Cramér和Wold 1936;Epps和Pulley 1983)。 随机方向和多比例频格产生一个基于Fourier定界特征(Ansari、Scarlett和Soh 2020;Knop等人,2020年)的可分化的小批量目标。 我们指出理想化的所有方向、所有频率差异的终点可识别性,并对照替代终点、路径和可能性目标评估其实际的有限网格替代物。

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 有关工作

blocks.en:
Normalizing flows learn tractable invertible transformations between a
reference law and a data distribution, with maximum-likelihood training
enabled by the change-of-variables formula ( Dinh, Sohl-Dickstein, and Bengio 2017 ; Kingma and Dhariwal 2018 ; Chen et al. 2018 ; Grathwohl et al. 2019 ) .
Their invertibility has also been exploited for unpaired domain
translation through shared latent representations and cycle consistency
induced by invertibility ( Grover et al. 2020 ) . Subsequent work has reduced
dependence on likelihood through sliced-Wasserstein matching ( Coeurdoux, Dobigeon, and Chainais 2022 ) , energy and proper-scoring-rule objectives and score matching ( Chao et al. 2023 ) .
Another strategy fits an auxiliary density model before learning the
transformation ( Golling et al. 2023 ) . These
approaches broaden the training objectives for invertible
models, but generally retain an analytically specified reference
distribution or rely on an auxiliary density model.

Continuous-time generative modeling has also developed toward
simulation-free path learning. Flow Matching trains vector fields along
prescribed conditional probability paths ( Lipman et al. 2023 ) ,
while minibatch and optimal-transport couplings can produce straighter
or lower-cost trajectories ( Pooladian et al. 2023 ) . Symmetric
MMD objectives combine bidirectional endpoint matching with transport
regularization to learn invertible maps directly from samples ( Xiong, Ding, and Zhang 2025 ) . Related developments extend flow-based
training to constrained and function-valued domains ( Xie et al. 2024 ; Kerrigan, Migliorini, and Smyth 2024 ) , conditional
distribution transfer ( Wahl et al. 2025 ) , and flow-map distillation ( Sabour, Fidler, and Kreis 2025 ) . Drifting methods provide another
sample-based perspective by evolving particles through distributional
velocity fields ( Deng et al. 2026 ) , with recent analyses
connecting these dynamics to Wasserstein gradient flows associated with
kernel, Sinkhorn, and sliced-Wasserstein discrepancies ( Gretton et al. 2026 ) . In contrast, our objective directly matches
the two endpoint laws without introducing a probability path or
coupling.

A complementary line of work characterizes distributions through
one-dimensional projections and characteristic functions. The
Cramér–Wold principle and empirical characteristic-function tests
provide the classical foundations ( Cramér and Wold 1936 ; Epps and Pulley 1983 ) . These ideas have been used for
latent distribution matching in autoencoders ( Knop et al. 2020 ) , implicit generative modeling through
weighted characteristic-function distances ( Ansari, Scarlett, and Soh 2020 ) , and joint distribution learning ( An and Jeon 2023 ; An, Hong, and Jeon 2023 ) . More recently, LeJEPA introduced
a scalable projected characteristic-function regularizer for matching
high-dimensional representations to an isotropic Gaussian ( Balestriero and LeCun 2025 ) , with subsequent work relating this
construction to sliced kernel discrepancies and simplified statistical
variants ( Zimmermann et al. 2025 ; Akbar 2026 ) . Our method
extends this characteristic-function mechanism to two-sample
matching between arbitrary endpoint distributions within a single
invertible map.

In the controlled benchmark, each method receives 512,000 training draws per endpoint, i.e., 500 updates at batch size 1,024 (methods with smaller batches take proportionally more updates); the ablations use 256 updates, except the architecture and ODE studies (128 updates) and the batch study (65,536 draws) in Table 5 . blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced PCF, a density-free objective for learning invertible
transports between sample-only distributions by matching projected empirical
characteristic functions in both directions, without prior densities,
adversarial training, or source–target couplings. Across controlled and
raw-pixel experiments, PCF matches kernel MMD at linear cost, with
strong sample efficiency and stable bidirectional training, while an optional
transport regularizer selects lower-displacement maps. Future work should
explore adaptive projections and frequencies for high-dimensional structured
domains.
